verdict.rationale: Proa documents server rendering on Axum, with Suspense boundaries that stream ready chunks out of order so slow data does not block the page. Islands then hydrate with server-rendered HTML plus a small JS module and seed state on a runtime of about 1.3 KB, which supports faster interactivity. Missing for 10: in-depth streaming docs (configuration, fallbacks, error handling are covered only by a single line), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the streaming and time-to-interactive claims.
